why: the zero-initialiser of `rclc_polling_service_t`, in rcl's `rcl_get_zero_initialized_*` shape. RFC-0022's polling tier, as its own type since phase-487 W2 (RFC-0096 D9, the C half). Nothing dispatches a polled service, so it has no arena slot and keeps its entity inline. The C++ twin is `nros::PollService<S>`.
